note: "Companies with more than 50 employees" names no field and sounds like a company-level entity; on this tenant company size is a profile attribute. The glossary context says so. Also "eligible for SEP" is the SEP eligibility flag, not Has SEP.

tools.name: aep_find_profile_fields

Searches the sandbox's full profile schema (every field group in the profile union) by field title, name and description, and returns real field paths with their type, title, description and allowed values. Use the returned paths in PQL exactly as given.
